name: AIRTECH SYSTEMS INDIA PVT LTD
india_angle: Airtech Systems India provides cleanroom solutions with a focus on the pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare sectors in India.
summary: Airtech Systems India specializes in providing comprehensive turnkey cleanroom solutions, primarily for the pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare industries. Their offerings include design, construction, validation, and maintenance of cleanroom environments, adhering to high regulatory standards.
